tested:
ISRv (Integrated Services Virtual Router) - same IOS-XE family as CSR1000v,
documented together in Cisco's own "CSR 1000v and Cisco ISRv Software
Configuration Guide". Had no entry here before 2026-07-12 - unmatched image
names fall through to GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (512MB/1cpu), which is nowhere near
enough: first-boot crypto keygen + package extraction under that much memory
pressure crash-loops (repeated "Failed to format /dev/vdaN. Rebooting."),
easily misread as a broken image (same failure shape as the dynamips
out-of-range-RAM SIGSEGV found the same day - see DYNAMIPS_MAX_RAM_MB above).
4096MB/2cpu mirrors this table's existing csr1000v entry (same vendor family
minimum); EVE-NG's own isrv-17.03.02 howto independently confirms 4096MB is
the correct order of magnitude (they run 1 vCPU/4096MB for a lighter profile).
default_ram_mb is 6144, not 4096 (2026-07-21, re-applied 2026-07-23 - see that date's
commit for why): same fix and same reason as the sibling csr1000v entry above (both
are Cisco IOS-XE platforms, documented together in Cisco's own "CSR1000v and ISRv
Software Configuration Guide"): min_ram_mb==default_ram_mb left zero real-world
headroom above the bare floor. Live-observed 2026-07-21 (config-lifecycle sweep round
8): 2 different isrv instances (isrv-21e32d3e, isrv-ucmk9-0beacd55) both climbed to
97-100% of the 4096MB cap and sat there for 4.5+ minutes - the same "hung under memory
pressure" signature already root-caused for csr1000v. min_ram_mb stays at 4096,
unchanged. RE-CONFIRMED live 2026-07-23: a bulk catalog-regeneration commit
(309ff0f7, "populate the 73 EVE-NG-template gaps") silently reverted this same fix
back to 4096/4096 without anyone noticing, re-exposing the exact same OOM-hang this
entry already fixed once - caught only because a live sweep hit isrv again and this
RAM value was the first thing checked. If you're regenerating/bulk-populating this
table from a template, please diff against evidence-backed comments like this one
first - a template regen has no way to know a manually-tuned value came from a real,
reproduced incident.
